name: GitHub PR Feedback Handling
purpose: Address and resolve reviewer comments with minimal targeted changes and test evidence.
inputs: Pull request URL and complete unresolved thread inventory
Review verdict, blocking questions, and scope boundary
Current commits, regression tests, and CI state
outputs: Thread inventory with fix, test, question, or dispute disposition
Targeted commits, replies, and failing-first regression tests
Green CI, re-review request, and zero-unresolved-thread confirmation
stop_conditions: All threads have a disposition, blocking fixes have tests, CI is green, and review is re-requested
